_doc: Built-in defaults. Don't edit this file: put overrides in ~/.crew/config.json (or $CREW_CONFIG), by hand or with `crew.py set-role` / `crew.py set-agent`. Your file is merged over this one key by key. Role agents are fallback lists: the first installed candidate is used, skipping the calling agent's own vendor when another candidate is installed. A role with "other_family": true refuses to run on the caller's own model family unless --agent names the agent. Claude agents use full model ids, because Claude Code's short aliases can lag a release (claude 2.1.286 still maps 'haiku' to Haiku 4.5).

models._doc: Models by name. Use one as --agent <name>[@effort], or say it naturally ("gemini flash medium"). efforts lists what the model takes; default_effort is used when none is given. For agy the effort is part of the model id ({effort}). Check what your CLIs offer with `crew.py models`.

sol.about: OpenAI's main Codex model: reviews and harder builds

astra.about: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra: frontier reasoning, slower and dearer

luna.about: OpenAI GPT-6 Luna: fast and cheap; light builds, lookups

opus.about: Anthropic's strongest everyday model: reviews, hard builds

haiku.about: Anthropic small model: cheap research, summaries

fable.about: Anthropic frontier model: the hardest problems

gemini-flash.about: Google Gemini 3.8 Flash with Google Search built in: cheap research

gemini-pro.about: Google Gemini 3.1 Pro; newer agy versions may not offer it

agy-opus.about: Claude Opus 5.5 through agy: saves your Claude plan, same model family

agy-sonnet.about: Claude Sonnet 5.5 through agy: saves your Claude plan, same model family

gpt-oss.about: OpenAI's open-weight gpt-oss 120B through agy; one effort setting

review.about: Code review of a diff (--target uncommitted | commit:<sha> | base:<branch>). Can build and run tests; repository changes are flagged.

check.about: Second opinion on a plan, claim, design or specific code. Can build and run tests to back its findings.

implement.about: Bounded implementation. Edits the working tree, never commits; the caller checks the result and commits.

implement-light.about: Cheap mechanical work: boilerplate, fixtures, test scaffolding, docs from code.

research.about: Web research and documentation lookups. Answers with sources.

light.about: Light read-only work: summarise files or logs, draft prose, simple lookups.
